info.title: Telecom Offer Advisor API
info.description: Phase 5: employee approval, voice and typed AI conversations, verified replies, saved outcomes, temporary speech caching, and dashboard estimates. Money uses integer minor units (100 = 1 AZN); timestamps use UTC. Accepted means confirmed interest for employee processing, never activation.

get.description: Phase 4: aggregate metrics from recommendations and saved call outcomes.
Phase 2: sort by score descending, savings descending, then customer ID ascending.
Phase 2: profile, three months of usage, recommendation, and previous call/result.

post.description: Phase 3: idempotent approval; approved_by is a demo label, not authenticated identity.
Phase 3: require approval and contact eligibility; retries reuse start_request_id.

get.description: Phase 3: state, immutable offer snapshot, ordered turns, and result; expire stale calls.

delete.description: Development only: remove a closed call and allow its approved offer to be called again.

post.description: Record employee approval of a customer's confirmed package interest for processing.

Typed or recorded customer input; retries reuse client_turn_id within a call.

The browser caps recordings at 20 seconds. The server caps files at 2 MiB and the
complete multipart body at 3 MiB; validates MIME/container signatures; transcribes
English speech; and sends the transcript through the same controller as typed input.
Retry audio with the identical file, or the saved transcript as text, using the same ID.

get.description: Phase 4: generate/cache speech for a saved, verified assistant turn only.

post.description: Phase 3: idempotently close unresolved calls; preserve previously confirmed outcomes.

audio.title: Audio
audio.description: Audio OR text, exactly one. Audio limit: 2 MiB.

staff_time_assumption.title: Staff Time Assumption
staff_time_assumption.default: 5 minutes manual handling minus 1 minute employee review
